subject: Integrator Ops Onramp — Ignite partner bootcamp
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily@solutionspark.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: partnership@solutionspark.com
Date: 2026-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Integrator ops onramp — initial request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick connect yesterday. SolutionSpark is excited to accelerate our integration with Redwood — we hear great things about the runtime and we want our consultants ready to recommend Redwood to enterprise customers.

High-level ask: can Redwood run a 2-day "Integrator Ops" onramp for our solution engineers and pre-sales consultants the week of Nov 9? Goal: hands-on labs (deploying a reference LLM pipeline), ops runbook (routing/fallback patterns), and an enablement kit (playbooks & slide decks). Target audience: 10 consultants (mix of SRE/SE).

Questions for you:
- Do you have a standard onramp curriculum or should we co-build?
- What environment access is required for lab work (VPC, dedicated vs hosted)?
- Any classroom capacity or trainer pre-reqs we should know about?

I've attached a short partner intake and a list of our preferred dates/constraints.

[Attachment: partner-questionnaire.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call to align.

Best,
Emily Chen
Director, Partnerships
SolutionSpark
Emily@solutionspark.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@solutionspark.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com, marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-10-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integrator ops onramp — initial request

Emily —

Really glad SolutionSpark is prioritizing this. We do have a base curriculum we use for SI onramps and can tailor it to your SE/SRE mix. I've sketched a proposed 2-day agenda below and attached a compact proposal with logistics and estimate.

Proposed 2-day agenda (draft)
Day 1: Foundations + Hosted-to-Private mapping
- 09:00 Introductions & success criteria
- 09:30 Platform architecture & serving runtime deep-dive
- 11:00 Lab 1: Hosted quickstart (deploy + inference)
- 14:00 Lab 2: KV cache + batching patterns
Day 2: Ops & Rollouts
- 09:00 Monitoring & tracing (Console walkthrough)
- 10:30 Lab 3: Canary rollouts + fallback to smaller model
- 14:00 Runbook exercise + mutual action planning

Pre-reqs for labs:
- A sandbox project in your cloud with outbound access; we can run hosted sessions if customers prefer no infra.
- Per-person laptop with Docker.

I attached the Ignite Onramp proposal (logistics + trainer bios). Core Redwood leads for this are: Rishi (SI enablement), Stephanie (field training), and Marcus (partner ops).

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/ignite-onramp-2026
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3247

If Nov 9 works we can lock trainers and send invites; otherwise propose Nov 16 as alternate.

[Attachment: ignite-onramp-proposal.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Partner GTM Lead
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com, marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-10-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integrator ops onramp — internal planning

Team —

SolutionSpark confirmed interest and proposed Nov 9 (or Nov 16). Can we treat this as a paid enablement (estimate attached) and reserve:
- Rishi: lead trainer (runtime & rollouts)
- Stephanie: labs + console walkthroughs
- Marcus: kickoff & JV runbook co-author (ops/FTR)

Prep checklist:
- Confirm trainer availability (block calendars now)
- Prep trainer bios doc and short slide deck (2 slides each)
- Provision a sandbox project for Lab 2 (if they opt for private infra) — Marcus to coordinate with Partner Ops.
- Deliverables: training recording, enablement kit (playbook + slides), mutual action plan (HubSpot).

I'll send the external confirmation once you confirm availability.

Thanks,
Kim

From: Emily Chen <emily@solutionspark.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: partnership@solutionspark.com
Date: 2026-10-15T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integrator ops onramp — initial request

Kimberly —

Nov 9 works for us. Appreciate the agenda — it looks great. A few follow-ups:
- Can you share trainer bios (for approvals on our side)?
- We'll need a pre-work doc to share with the cohort (1 pager + list of env setup steps).
- For the sandbox: can Redwood host labs in hosted mode for the first run? That avoids VPC setup and simplifies SRE access for participants.

We'll also attach a quick PO template if we need to formalize the paid engagement next week.

Thanks — Emily

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@solutionspark.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com, marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-10-16T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integrator ops onramp — Ignite partner bootcamp (Confirmed)

Emily —
